name: Mitesh Masurkar
tagline: I turn ball-by-ball data into IPL selection decisions.
available_for: Analyst roles with IPL franchises, cricket analytics teams and broadcasters
about: I build decision tools out of cricket data. StatEdge, the project on this site, started with a simple frustration: most cricket numbers describe what happened, and a selector needs to know what to do next. Who opens, who bowls the last over, which overseas player makes way, and how much of a good season is luck.

I work end to end, from the raw match data to a finished application a selector can use. I care as much about what the numbers cannot tell you as what they can, and every figure on this site comes with that distinction.
